text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- (U.N. envoy) Ekeus and (Iraqi deputy premier) Aziz meet again.
- Iraqi delegation meets deputy speaker of Turkish parliament in Ankara.
- Article stresses necessity of adherence to President Saddam Hussein's call for austerity.
- Campaign to repair irrigation projects in Nineveh province.
- Editorial says U.N. arms official Ekeus lacks credibity.
- Editorial urges Ekeus to give up his doubts about Iraq's past weapons programmes and declare Iraq clean of such weapons.
